properties.description: Convert all csv in curated folder to parquet

source:
df_trips = spark.read.option("header", True) \
    .option("inferSchema", True) \
    .csv("abfss://transportationdata@adlstransproject.dfs.core.windows.net/curated/trips/")

df_trips_clean = df_trips.dropDuplicates()

df_trips_clean.write.mode("overwrite").parquet(
    "abfss://transportationdata@adlstransproject.dfs.core.windows.net/curated_parquet/trips/"
)

print("Trips parquet created")
